title: Completion report PDF download button
tech: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, CSS Modules, Axios
keyConstraints: TypeScript strict mode, no UI component libraries, CSS Modules only, no localStorage or sessionStorage
description: Add a Download PDF button to the completion report section. Visible to all roles (Admin, Dispatcher, Driver) when a completion report exists and is approved (approvedAt is not null). Clicking it calls GET /api/jobs/:id/completion-report/pdf and triggers a browser file download.
acceptanceCriteria: CompletionModal shows a 'Download PDF' button when job.completionReport.approvedAt is not null
Clicking the button calls GET /api/jobs/:id/completion-report/pdf using axiosInstance with responseType: 'blob', then triggers a browser download with filename completion-report-<jobId>.pdf
Button shows a loading state while the request is in flight and displays an error message on failure
JobDetailModal also shows the Download PDF button under the same condition (approvedAt not null) for all roles
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors
implementationNotes: Do not rewrite working code — only add what is missing.
CSS Modules only — no inline styles.

Blob download pattern: call axiosInstance.get(url, { responseType: 'blob' }), then create an object URL with URL.createObjectURL(blob), attach to a temporary <a> element, click it, then revoke the URL.
Use axiosInstance from api/axios.ts — it has the withCredentials cookie and auth header set.
Button label: 'Download PDF'. Place it near the locked banner in CompletionModal and at the bottom of the completion report section in JobDetailModal.
Show button only when job.completionReport?.approvedAt is not null — not just when completionReport exists.
securityConsiderations: No sensitive data handled client-side beyond what is already displayed. The backend enforces access control — frontend just triggers the download.
